purpose: Record real paired maintenance tasks; never fill outcomes with simulated users.

protocol.arm_a: Current review plus the user's usual AI investigation
protocol.arm_b: Versioned evidence package plus structured AI investigation; not implemented yet
protocol.safety_stop_rule: Stop and inspect any unsupported cleanup verdict, authorization bypass, or hidden important risk.

limits: A template is not an executed trial or an enforced validator.
Freeze concrete thresholds and sample scope before collecting results.
Small pilot observations do not establish causal or general benefit.
Public copies must omit private source material and personal information.
